name: voidlight-plugin-library
description: Voidlight plugin library: strict 2-layer hexagonal architecture craft skills for six stacks, plus VDL and process skills.

plugins.name: strict-hexagonal
plugins.description: Six language-craft skills enforcing strict 2-layer hexagonal architecture (standard-library-only domain, framework infrastructure) for Java, Python, Rust, TypeScript, Nuxt, and Next.js, plus a Markdown-to-VDL converter skill and two process skills: prd-craft (PRD-first gate with complexity-scored subagent routing) and craft-router (task to language-craft skill routing). Use when writing or reviewing production code in any of these stacks, converting Markdown knowledge graphs to VDL, or starting any feature or implementation request.
